broad_empirical_priors.description: Broad empirical founder priors derived from focused_yuya_kv55_grandparent_l1_l2_founders by shrinking each locus toward a uniform allele distribution. Explicit person-specific founder genotype priors are removed.

restricted_endogamous_priors.description: Restricted endogamous founder priors derived from focused_yuya_kv55_grandparent_l1_l2_founders by concentrating each locus on the observed/listed allele pool and capping 'other' mass. Explicit person-specific founder genotype priors are removed.

note: The matrix uses three distinct settings: baseline reference frequencies and the two listed variants.
